strings.en: ...Why...? O beings who dwell in this universe...
Children... of the Land of Beginning... Why...
The will... of this universe...
Following it... we have guarded the Land of Beginning...
The will... of the universe...!?
I heard about it from Dr. Saotome... The will of the universe...
In this universe, there exists a will that seeks to nurture life...
And one answer to that is...
Getter Rays...
Dangerous powers... springing up only in the Land of Beginning...
We judged that the humans who unite them... must be studied too...
And the ones... we set our eyes on then...
...The test subjects were me... and Kyosuke,
back when that shuttle made its descent to Earth, huh...
Your body was... nearly destroyed in those flames.
So we grafted our flesh onto you... and regenerated you...
Don't tell me what you made after that was...
......Created for someone else's convenience... I can't stand that.
...Excellen...
What regenerated you... was none other than... Person-Lichkeit...
And I was made... from the data left in it...
...So it's something like my brother Kyoji...?
A cyborg built from DG Cells... but...
...Then... why choose only Excellen?
If you'd taken me too... things might not have turned out like this.
Huh!? You wanted to join them!?
That's not it! Kyosuke... just wanted to make sure, didn't he?
...That... was impossible... Because... you...
...Kyosuke, in that situation... you hadn't died...
What...!?
You mean... he survived on his own!?
...A true... miracle...!?
Is that even possible...!? No... but...
So you studied humans based on Excellen?
You didn't do your homework!
The little lady who sided with us looks just like her, sure,
but you're a monster that looks nothing like her!
I'm... nothing more than a copy... an empty one...
Incomprehensible... Why... could we not... create humans...
The aura... is gone.
Mm...! I see... So it's over...
Akira?
...Raideen told me... It's over, Mari.
...Your mistake was kidnapping only me, wasn't it, Alchemie dear?
What... do you mean...?
Well, you set out to give birth to a new life,
but you only studied me, a woman. No way that makes a human, right?
I'm a child too, so.
Something so completely obvious...
was missing from the Einst series, then.
For beings who watched over the Land of Beginning, Earth,
since ancient times... it may not be a fitting end, but...
That's how the world tends to be, more often than not.
Let us return, everyone.
The hard part begins now. ...You too, Miss Alchemie.
...Huh?
You helped us.
...You helped save our universe from this terrible one.
...You're truly one of us now.
This universe of ours is full of people like this.
...Come on over.
...But... there's no... time left...
We have a problem.
Wh-What is it, Ruri-Ruri?
The way in and out of this space... has closed.
What!? What does that mean!?
Then, could it be that we...
C-Can't go home!?
What about communications!?
...No good. We've been trying for a while now...
How the heck are we s'posed to get back to Earth!?
...Will we wander this universe... forever?
Kosuke! Don't say such ominous things!
But there ain't nothin' we can do...
Damn it... At this rate... winning won't mean a thing!
Alchemie! What's going on!
......The collapse has begun.
Because two universes... cannot exist in the same space...
Easy to get in, no way back out, huh. What now!?
That's it, Mia. Didn't Dr. Tarsan say something!?
About Earth having a special force field.
...No matter where you are in space, you can find Earth... I think...
He did, he did!
Princess Romina, what about the Elshank's radar!?
...Nothing on radar...
Captain Misumaru! What about a Boson Jump!?
No good... The field won't even form...!
Can't be helped. Well, they do say home is wherever you settle.
Hey, come on! Jet!
Isn't there... some way...
That's it...
We should be able to link the psycommu with the radar... Seabook.
I see... Using the bio-sensor?
Whoa, whoa, what are you trying to do!?
A bio-sensor... That's a part that makes a mech run better, right?
Strictly speaking, it's a system that responds to brainwaves.
It boosts unit response... But how would you use it here!?
...I see. Hook it straight into the radar display
and turn the machine itself into a sensor.
Exactly, Captain.
Seabook, can I count on you?
I'll give it a try.
...Holy Warrior... Show Zama... and everyone... please be safe.
Professor... It is no use.
I cannot detect... the brainwaves of Hyoma and the others...
...That can't be... The Combattler team...
and Londo Bell couldn't be beaten so easily...
But, Professor...
...We must believe, Ropet. It's all we can do.
How is it... Seabook?
...No good... I can't feel anything...
It's no use...!?
That's not like you, Shiro. Saying something so defeatist...
Aina... But if this keeps up...
If we can't get out of here... perhaps that's our fate.
Daisuke!? Don't say that...
But I think fate is just something you name after the fact.
...You say "that was fate," afterward.
So until that moment comes, let's struggle, however unsightly.
You're right, Brother... Seabook, is there anything we can do to help!?
...I don't know what to do either...
Amuro, the psycoframes.
The psycoframes... Bright, send every psycoframe
we have aboard over here.
What are you planning? Amuro.
I'll explain later. Please.
Captain Bright, we can launch the containers.
Understood. Release them.
Everyone, lend me your strength. Just wish to return to Earth.
Captain, is something that simple really enough?
Praying and wishing, ain't that a last resort!?
So it's time to use that last resort, huh.
It's not so simple. You must empty your mind, and to the pulse of life...
to the Earth that gave birth to us, you must open your senses...
Turning people's feelings into power... Quite romantic.
...All right, let's do it.
Heh, I'll wish as hard as you want.
We've gotta hurry back and clean up the Cyber Beast Force base anyway.
Yeah. We can't dawdle around in a place like this.
Let's go home. To Earth... and our colony.
Nina... I'll definitely... come back.
I wanna get back to my normal life... with Gramps and everyone.
Let's go home, Rain, Allenby. To the Earth Master and my brother loved.
Yes.
I wanna train together again, too.
I must also tell Kyoji... that I safely fulfilled my mission.
Mm...
And me... with Akito...
That's a stray thought. Focus properly, Captain.
In the Land of Beginning... let's start over again, Kyosuke.
...Yeah, it starts now. ...Hm? Where's Alchemie...?
Huh...!? But Person-Lichkeit was right there a moment ago...!?
(Alchemie...)
Seabook, take this.
This sword is...?
Kenrou shows the righteous path. Our feelings, and the hearts
of the people in the Earth Sphere waiting for our return...
It will surely answer them.
Seabook.
Yeah... Please... F91...!
Heaven and earth, fire and water... grant us your power...!
...Kou... come back.
...Still nothing?
Since they entered the Muge universe, we've had no word...
They're most likely trapped in another dimension, as I feared.
...But there's nothing we can do from here...
Come back to me, Roll, Mia, Pai, Lamba... my children.
Dear...
It's all right... I'm sure he's doing fine.
...Raideen and the star of La Mu will surely help Akira.
O star of La Mu... please grant those brave warriors strength...
...I can feel it... everyone's thoughts... everyone's wish to go home...
People can all... understand each other... feel each other...!
That's why... no matter how far apart we are...
we can feel each other's presence.
...Seabook!
There! ...That direction!
Turn the Elshank toward the direction Arno indicates, at once!
Yes, Your Highness!
Show... We can go back...! With this, we can!
Cham! Really!?
Come on...!
Please...!
Father...
......Ronin, what about the Nadesico?
...Still no contact, sir.
Which means... all of Londo Bell is in the same situation.
...Yes, sir...
All we can do is wait. ...Ronin,
You have friends among them too... but we must trust them and wait.
...I understand.
Even so... I'm worried... Yurikaaa...
(Joe... You, all of you, can make the impossible possible...
I believe in you.)
It's Earth!
Show! It's Earth!
Yeah... our planet...
Thank goodness...
...Whew...
Good work... Seabook.
Yeah... The sensor was just about to burn out...
People's feelings... I never knew they had so much power.
The psycoframes seem to have performed just as expected, too.
...Yeah.
I never imagined it had this much power... Honestly, I was surprised.
...The Einst series lost to us because they couldn't understand that power.
The seed... of life, huh.
Maybe that's where Getter Ray research ultimately leads.
...I believe it too.
And if something we can't handle happens because of it...
we'll just fight again.
Sounds like a lot of work, though.
Come on, let's not worry about the next fight right now.
We need to ease up a little.
...Even so... Earth really is pretty, isn't it?
Yes... It may be even more beautiful than Lilith...
Makes risking our lives to protect it worth it.
Earth is no longer the homeland of Earthlings alone...
That's right... All life in space was born from Earth, so we're all family.
We people of planet Cronos... came from the same place, too.
When hearts connect, differences in body don't matter.
Aw, let's skip the heavy stuff for now...
Geez... Koji, honestly.
I ain't no good with the heavy stuff either.
We are who we are, no matter what anyone says.
I wasn't sure how this would turn out...
but seeing Earth after a close call like that is kind of nice.
Really... Hey, Captain, got any beer? Beer.
Don't get carried away! We haven't made it home yet.
...Oh dear.
Hm... Mr. Garrison?
Ah, no... It's just that I have champagne prepared next door...
Oho...
Efficient as always, Garrison.
Wow! Hey, got any sake? Sake.
Weren't you having beer? ...Mixing drinks will get you drunk.
Mr. Garrison!
Not to worry. For those underage, there is juice...
Aww, no fair!
Is booze even any good?
I mean, if you put it that way, almost everyone here's underage!
No Romtron energy... huh.
Not even here. Be patient, Drill.
He~llo! This is the Nadesico~! Oh, Captain Bright!
How about a party? A wrap party!
Captain, your timing seems pretty much the worst.
There's no stopping it now, is there? Bright.
Don't tease me. ...Do whatever you want.
This unit never changes... Hm? ...Excellen, come with me.
Huh? Ah, wait, Kyosuke! Where are you going!? What about my beer!?
Alchemie.
You suddenly rushed out in the Alt, and... so you came, Alchemie.
I've been watching... all of you... the whole time.
Amazing, isn't it? The power of those who live in this universe...
That's what the "will of the universe" really is. Probably.
Even without the Einst's help, this world will perish when its time comes.
...But it's also up to us to prevent that.
You speak of yourself... with such confidence, Kyosuke.
He's usually not much of a talker, though.
This feeling...
Excellen, is it yours? Or is it...
If you think it's yours... then it is.
...I'm so happy... But it seems... it's too late...
Alchemie!? Person-Lichkeit is... crumbling...!
Get out of there, quick!
...It's no use... I was born in Person-Lichkeit... and
I cannot leave it... I'm a defective product...
What...!
In the end, I couldn't become anyone... I only wanted to be me...
Kyosuke, this girl...
Don't say anything. ...I know.
It's... a complicated feeling. Another me, huh.
A cruel ending. ...But
maybe it was what she wanted for herself...
You heard it.
...As of now, Federation independent unit Londo Bell is disbanded.
You civilians who joined the fighting under special wartime measures...
will be disembarking.
Yeah, yeah. ...Guess it's back to the boring life.
What are you saying, Koji? Peace is best.
That all went by... in a flash.
...It was all a fleeting dream... as they say.
Mazinger, Great, Getter...
They avoided dismantling, but will now be under Federation control.
If something like this happens again... it'll be hard to take them out.
Heh heh, there you go fibbing again. You'll fly out when it counts anyway.
It caused quite an uproar, you know.
When I took Great out of the robot museum for this war.
Each robot... as the only super robots in the military...
will be kept at the Far East Branch, along with Dancougar.
Huh? ...Oh, is that all? Then we can fly out anytime.
Locks there might as well not exist.
What a relief.
Hold on. What is that supposed to mean?
Just what it sounds like, Commander Hazuki. ...Well then.
Hm... You're leaving? Judau.
Yeah. Bright... I'm...
The Jupitris II... You're going back to Jupiter?
Not to follow in Scirocco's footsteps... I just feel like something's out there.
...That's just my own hunch, though.
This time, I'm coming with you.
Just try not to get in our way.
...All right. Thinking about Earth from outside might be good... I suppose.
Kamille, what about you?
Captain, I... I'm thinking of going down to Earth with Fa.
Kamille...!?
To Earth...? But down there...
Yes. What Amuro and Four once saw...
I want to see what lies at the bottom of the gravity well.
That thing colony people say, about souls being held down by gravity...
I never really get it.
I've never thought about it, but are we like that too?
If everyone were like you, Koji...
Earth and space wouldn't have ended up like this.
Whoa, that's rare! Kamille praising somebody!
That's not true. ...Well, Captain Bright, we'll be...
We never got to say proper goodbyes, but...
tell Amuro, Quattro and everyone else I said hi!
Thank you... for everything.
Yeah, take care.
So this is... farewell.
Yes. For protecting Earth...
thank you, truly.
Don't be so formal. Princess Romina's a sucker for that stuff.
Yeah, yeah. And Mr. Umon... take good care of it.
Peace on Mars, too.
Right. Besides, it seems Banjo and the others
are planning to rebuild Mars... It'll be fine.
Are you really... going to the Shema system?
You bet. The ninja legend... whether I'm really
the legendary ninja or not doesn't matter.
But after all they've done for me,
I've gotta repay the favor.
Joe... Joe, really...
Lenny's going too, y'know? Princess?
...That'll be rough.
Joe's going to have his hands full.
They're laughing at you, Joe.
My, it's lively here.
Princess Romina and the others... and Umon.
Are you leaving too?
Yes. We Cronosians
must fight evil across the universe. The solar system is safe now.
But... the Bunker hasn't been completely destroyed...
A new captain will rise and repeat the same things again...
So we're heading to the next galaxy.
Rom... thank you so much. You've saved us so many times...
Please raise your head, Princess Romina.
Tenku Chushin Ken teaches us to help those exposed to senseless violence.
I am only fighting according to that teaching.
Heh, smooth. ...Well then, we're off.
Yeah. ...Well... I hope we meet again someday.
Yes. This is the homeland of every living thing in the universe.
...Come back anytime. You'll be welcome.
Heading back to the Shema system?
Even with that jerk Annex gone, most of the Za Boom Army
is apparently still dug in around planet Radorio.
Until that army is driven off... our fight won't be over.
Umon, Rom... I pray we may meet again, alive...
Princess Romina... don't say that!
Well now, let's get going too, Rom.
Where are you headed?
Anywhere evil runs rampant.
...Come to think of it... I hear a planet called Radorio
is suffering an unjust invasion, Jet.
Geez, that's so like you, Brother.
Radorio? Hm... I've heard of it.
So that's our next stop, Rom?
Yes.
Rom...
Thanks, man. ...You sure about this?
It's just like Rom said.
Wherever Master Rom and Miss Leina go,
I shall simply follow, no matter how far.
...I pray for your victory, my friends from other stars like me.
So it's over, huh.
Why do you sound so disappointed? Watch what you say.
Exactly!
The fighting's over, so we should be happier!
I kinda think Captain Yurika should be more serious during battle, though.
But why is the Cyber Beast Force on the Nadesico?
Thanks to Muge's double, the Cyber Beast Force base is a wreck.
There's no telling when it'll be rebuilt.
Until then, we'll be borrowing space at Sasebo.
So Nergal has its good side after all.
How rude.
Nergal is not such a greedy company, you know.
Heh, I bet you're grabbing our Cyber Beast data
to build some "Wild Frame" or something, huh?
Cool.
...A proposal like that would never get approved.
Yo! You guys look bored.
Hi, everyone~
Oh, it's the Dangaioh team. ...So you're leaving, huh?
Yes.
Thank you for everything, everyone.
You don't have to leave if you don't want to, you know?
No... I want to go with Dr. Tarsan and see all kinds of planets.
And with all of you here, I know our home is safe.
Heh heh, just leave it to me, Gai Daigoji!
Flattery won't get you anything, y'know?
I never expected to get anything out of you from the start, Fujiwara.
What'd you say? You picking a fight? Huh?
Knock it off, you two.
Guess we won't get to see this anymore, huh?
Heh, that's right. See ya, Fujiwara.
...Yeah. Later.
Too bad. They were pretty easy on the eyes.
Ah~, so that's how you were looking at us!? Masato, you perv!
Masato, you slipped up at the very last moment.
Uribatake was making figures of the Dangaioh team,
so I recommend you make do with those.
Ah, you idiot! Ruri! Don't tell them!
Geez~!
(I guess there isn't... one of me, huh...)
Uribatake, no misusing them! Well... we're off.
My... no, our home... please take care of it.
Leave it to us! Well, we'll look forward to seeing you again.
Lieutenants Uraki and Amada... went back to Torrington Base?
...And Domon and his group?
They went home to their colonies. Neo Japan had it especially hard.
On that note, there's good news.
It seems Dr. Mikamura won't be charged over this incident.
So it was all Major Ulube's doing. ...That leaves Seabook's group...
What about them? I hear no news of the Crossbone Vanguard either...
I sent them back to Frontier IV together. They're civilians, after all...
...Weren't you one too, once, Captain Amuro?
They're Newtypes... and outstanding ones at that.
What are you getting at?
...That they should enlist and walk the same path as you and me?
Don't get so worked up. I know you're betting on the power of youth.
...Speaking of the young ones... I don't see the Zambot team either?
I sent them down to Earth with Hibiki and the others.
They have families...
Now that the fighting's over, there's no need to hold them.
Ah, Captain Amuro! And Captain Quattro too.
Chan.
Captain Quattro... I heard you're leaving the military...
Yes, Londo Bell is disbanding. ...I'll retire from active duty too.
Well then, excuse me.
Char.
...The next time we meet... we may be enemies.
Amuro!?
Captain Quattro, that's not true, is it!?
We're comrades who fought together, aren't we!?
...Chan Agi. Grow into a fine woman.
Huh? Ah, y-yes, sir!
Everyone... has gone back to where they came from...
Yeah.
Kyosuke... what will you do...?
...I'm staying in the military.
I see...
...Is something bothering you?
...Yeah. The Einst series... all turned to dust in that universe, right?
Yeah. Once we beat the biggest one, the rest lost cohesion and crumbled.
But... I'm still here.
...If I just disappeared too, then they'd be...
I told you once before... to stay just as you are.
If it ever comes to that... I'll kill you myself. ...So don't worry.
Okay... Hee hee, is that any way to comfort a girl? A real killer line, huh?
Heh... That's the spirit. Stay by my side, Excellen...
